modules-extra.camera-view.no-camera.note: Shown in the camera module when no camera entity is chosen.

modules-extra.custom-card-view.failed-to.note: Error in the custom card module. {type} is the card type the user entered, for example custom:my-card. {error} is a technical message from the browser and is not translated.

vars.error: The value that replaces error in the text.
vars.type: The value that replaces type in the text.

modules-extra.custom-card-view.home-assi.text: Home Assistant card helpers are not available
modules-extra.custom-card-view.home-assi.note: Error in the custom card module. Home Assistant's built-in card loader could not be found, so the embedded card cannot be created.

modules-extra.forecast-view.day.note: Label of the daytime temperature in a weather forecast, opposite of Night. Not the calendar day.

modules-extra.forecast-view.forecast-not.note: Error in the forecast module. {error} is a technical message from Home Assistant and is not translated.

vars.error: The value that replaces error in the text.

modules-extra.forecast-view.night.note: Label of the night-time temperature in a weather forecast, opposite of Day.

modules-extra.forecast-view.no-forecast-.note: Shown in the forecast module when the weather entity returned an empty forecast.

modules-extra.forecast-view.this-entity-.note: Shown in the forecast module when the chosen entity is not a weather entity or does not offer a forecast.

modules-extra.graphs-view.history-unavai.note: Shown in the graph module when the history of the entity could not be fetched.

modules-extra.graphs-view.loading-histor.note: Shown in the graph module while the entity's history is being fetched.

modules-extra.graphs-view.name-last-hour.text: {name}: last {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
modules-extra.graphs-view.name-last-hour.note: Title of a graph. {name} is the entity's name. {hours} is the length of the period shown, in hours.

vars.hours: The count the text is about.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

modules-extra.graphs-view.no-numeric-his.note: Shown in the graph module when the entity's history has no numbers to plot, for example a text sensor.

modules-extra.image-view.picture-not-ava.note: Shown in the image module when the entity has no picture or it failed to load.

modules-extra.tabs-view.empty-tab.note: Shown in the tabs module when the selected tab has no content.
